defs.def: ot often 不常；很少；难得

ex.s: They seldom cause arguments among scientists.
ex.t: 很少引起科学家之间的争论。

ex.s: Then I would try to remember the different possessions I supposedly had taken away—since I seldom actually kept them.
ex.t: 然后我会试着记起我假想中被拿走的不同财物——因为我其实很少真的留下它们。

ex.s: 14.Why does the man seldom do exercise？
Why does the man seldom do exercise？
ex.t: 这个男人为什么很少锻炼？

ex.s: The things we learn in maturity seldom involve information and skills． We learn to bear with the things we can't change． We learn to avoid self﹣pity． We learn that however much we try to please， some people are never going to love us﹣an idea that troubles at first but is eventually relaxing．
ex.t: 我们在成熟时学到的东西很少涉及信息和技能。我们学会忍受无法改变的事。我们学会避免自怜。我们学到，无论多么努力取悦，有些人永远不会爱我们——这个想法起初令人困扰，但最终令人释然。

ex.s: The pressures of "time" and "destination" are further blocks to awareness． I encountered many hikers who were headed to a distant camp﹣ground with just enough time to get there before dark． It seldom occurred to them to wander a bit， to take a moment to see what's around them． I asked them what they'd seen． "Oh， a few birds， "they said． They seemed bent on their destinations．
ex.t: 时间和'目的地'的压力是觉悟的进一步障碍。我遇到许多徒步者，他们赶往一个遥远的营地，刚好有足够时间在天黑前到达。他们很少想到要闲逛一会儿，花点时间看看周围有什么。我问他们看到了什么。'哦，几只鸟，'他们说。他们似乎一心奔着目的地。

ex.s: It was not only for the delicious food that we seldom got to eat, but for the opportunity to have our whole family gathered together.
ex.t: 我们 seldom 能吃到这些美味食物，不仅为了食物，也为了全家团聚的机会。

ex.t: 天候专家说,这样的严重干旱 很少 气候变化组织已经做了一个步骤 我们需要取水。

ex.s: In my last job, I spent so muchtime in meetings that we seldom had time to work!
ex.t: 在我上一份工作里,我花了这么多时间开会,以至于我们很少有时间工作!

ex.s: T / F 5 Students who are addicted to the Internet seldom get bored.
ex.t: T/F 5 对互联网上瘾的学生很少感到无聊.

ex.s: Familiar objects and events seldom present themselves to our senses in the way that science requires them to be viewed, where they can have a rational explanation.
ex.t: 熟悉的物体和事件很少以科学要求人们去看待的方式呈现出来,在那里他们可以有一个合理的解释.
